request:
Which classes name JupyterMixin (from rich/jupyter.py) directly as a base class but do not define their own __rich_measure__ method in their class body? Give each class's symbol ID.

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string).
explanation: The query finds all class symbols that inherit from JupyterMixin by joining symbols with class_bases, then excludes any classes that have a heading named '__rich_measure__' at ordinal 1 (the class body definition). This yields classes that directly name JupyterMixin as a base but lack their own __rich_measure__ method.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
WHERE cb.base_name = 'JupyterMixin'
  AND s.symbol_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT s2.symbol_id
    FROM code.symbols s2
    JOIN code.headings h ON s2.file_id = h.file_id
    WHERE h.heading = '__rich_measure__'
      AND h.value IS NOT NULL
      AND h.ordinal = 1
  )
